scope: Independent minterm oracle validates every reported shard sample digest, all-lane state popcounts, complete exported first-shard snapshots and every trace frame. Covers seed/data global offsets, nonmultiple final shards, overlapping-window avoidance, sparse coverage, warmup, zero ticks, default/explicit grid caps and theoretical occupancy arithmetic. High counter seeds are tested at small global offsets; this does not validate allocations above the uint32 word boundary.
